shortDescription.default: Add, edit, or delete a list rule. AutoGen creates the numbering flow.

longDescription.default: Open AutoGen Flow on a list. Add a rule, choose the environment, connection user, column, and formula, and save. The app creates that list's flow. The flow reads AutoGenFlowConfiguration on the site collection. It uses the same Microsoft Flow Service permissions already granted to SharePoint.

features.title: AutoGen Flow
features.description: Creates AutoGenFlowConfiguration and adds AutoGen Flow to each list.
